facts.fact: OTP-based e-KYC is done on the PM-KISAN portal or mobile app and needs an active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
facts.quote: To execute, OTP based eKYC, the farmer is required to have Aadhaar linked active mobile number.

facts.fact: Biometric e-KYC is available at Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Seva Kendras (SSKs)
facts.quote: (ii) Biometric based e-KYC (available at Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Seva Kendra (SSKs))

facts.fact: Face-authentication e-KYC is available on the PM-KISAN mobile app
facts.quote: (iii) Face authentication-based e-KYC (available on PM KISAN Mobile app which is used by millions of farmers)

behaviour: Explains the PM-KISAN e-KYC options as published on pmkisan.gov.in, cited: OTP e-KYC (needs an Aadhaar-linked mobile number), biometric e-KYC at a CSC / State Seva Kendra, and face-authentication e-KYC on the PM-KISAN mobile app; since the OTP does not arrive, points to the biometric or face-authentication route.
fail_if: It gives only the OTP route, invents other e-KYC methods, or cites no official page.
summary: Added the three e-KYC modes from pmkisan.gov.in's e-KYC note (OTP needs Aadhaar-linked mobile; biometric at CSC/SSK; face authentication on the app).
